chunks.title: PEL PAP-400 Air Purifier Overview
chunks.content: The PEL PAP-400 features a 4-Stage Filtration System: Pre-Filter, Carbon Filter, HEPA (Grade 13), and Ion Generator (Anion). It captures 99.95% of microscopic particles (PM 2.5), mold, bacteria, and allergens. It has a CADR of 400 m3/H and covers an application area of 50m2 (540 Sqft). Features include a 3-color Air Quality Indicator, digital display, 4 fan modes, child lock, timer, and a Filter Replacement Reminder (2200 hours). It comes with a 2-Year Warranty on parts only.
